Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities joined to assays, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by assay CHEMBL1613842, standard_value not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
